name: Specialty Metals
about:
Specialty Metals Corporation operates from Kent, Washington, and has been in business since 1981. The company runs a full-service metal fabrication shop at 8300 South 206th Street, offering cutting, forming, and finishing under one roof.

The shop provides water jet cutting, 5,000-watt laser cutting, plasma and oxy-fuel cutting, metal forming, pipe bending, plate sawing, and laser engraving. It stocks a range of metals including stainless steel, aluminum, alloy, and carbon steel, as well as rubber and composites for water jet work, and processes all materials in-house. The facility serves both wholesale and direct-to-consumer orders.

Quality requirements posted by the company reference NADCAP, ISO 9001, and AS9100 standards, along with aerospace first-article inspection per AS9102, indicating a customer base in aerospace, defense, and federal sectors. The company also supplies general industrial and construction markets with building products and hard-to-find metal items.

Specialty Metals emphasizes its one-stop-shop model: materials are stocked on site and processed internally, allowing the firm to offer both wholesale and retail sales without outsourcing core fabrication steps.
